title: AP Cybersecurity Exam
activity: Section I: Multiple Choice (60 questions, 80 minutes). Section II: Free Response — Device Security Analysis (50 minutes). Good luck!

title: Post-Exam Kickoff: Design a Defense-in-Depth Plan
activity: Decompress from the AP Exam; introduce the capstone project - in teams, design a full defense-in-depth security plan (physical, network, device, application/data layers) for a chosen organization (school, hospital, small business, etc.).

title: Capstone Work Day 1: Risk Assessment & Control Selection
activity: Teams identify assets/threats/vulnerabilities for their chosen organization and select managerial/technical/physical controls across all 4 layers.

title: Capstone Work Day 2: Detection Plan & Incident-Response Tabletop
activity: Teams design a detection strategy (tools + IoCs) and run a short tabletop exercise simulating response to a chosen attack scenario.

title: Cybersecurity Careers & Certifications Panel
activity: Explore NICE Workforce Framework career roles; discuss next-step industry certifications (CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity); optional guest speaker from a local employer or college cybersecurity program.

title: Capstone Presentations
activity: Teams present their defense-in-depth plans to the class; peer feedback using a rubric aligned to the 4 Course Skill categories.

title: Course Wrap-Up & Reflection
activity: Self-assessment against the 4 Course Skill categories; course feedback survey; preview pathways (Security+ study track, CTF/cyber clubs, capstone showcase for the department).
